assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final production homepage brand artwork for FixFlags, light theme.
Primary request: Create a beautiful, exceptionally crisp high-resolution studio rendering of the FixFlags folded F in translucent orange optical glass, closely matching the provided reference. This is a new native render, not an upscale or reproduction of JPEG artifacts.
Input image: reference image only, for exact logo silhouette and glass material.
Subject: one upright folded-F mark, consisting of exactly TWO separate shapes: a tall angular inverted-L upper/stem piece with rising diagonal top and a detached short parallelogram crossbar below its top-right arm. Preserve the reference's unmistakable silhouette, proportions, separation and positive diagonal angles. No extra bars, no conventional typographic F.
Style: premium restrained 3D product photography, razor-clean bevels and polished transparent glass, physically plausible refraction, restrained Flag Orange #FF5A00 core fading to clear glass faces, elegant thin specular edges.
Composition: SQUARE 1:1, preferably 2048x2048 native resolution or higher. Center the COMPLETE mark horizontally and vertically. Mark occupies 48 percent of image width and 68 percent of height, with generous even clear margins. Upright frontal three-quarter view, very shallow depth, both pieces coplanar. Entire mark and its soft shadow fully visible.
Scene: seamless warm paper-white studio background matching #F9F8F6, subtly matte floor, gentle orange caustic beneath, pale neutral corners. Soft large studio lighting from upper left, tiny crisp highlights, refined quiet editorial feel.
Constraints: No text, typography, UI, dashboard, charts, furniture, props, frame, watermark, borders or additional symbols. No noisy grain, pixelation, chromatic fringing, blown highlights, excessive bloom or neon. Keep crisp glass detail and clean surfaces. Match the supplied reference's brand identity closely.
